'''Jane Margaret O'Brien''' (born 1953),<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Jane Margaret O'Brien, Ph.D. |url=https://msa.maryland.gov/msa/mdmanual/25univ/stmarys/former/html/msa14081.html |website=Maryland State Archives}}</ref> also known as '''Maggie O'Brien''',<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |last=Badger |first=Sylvia |date=May 12, 1996 |title=St. Mary's College pays tribute to its president, Edward Lewis |url=http://articles.baltimoresun.com/1996-05-12/features/1996133124_1_board-member-mary-college-lewis |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140517123134/http://articles.baltimoresun.com/1996-05-12/features/1996133124_1_board-member-mary-college-lewis |archive-date=May 17, 2014 |work=[[The Baltimore Sun]] |via=[[Wayback Machine]]}}</ref> is an American professor of chemistry, college president, and academic administrator. She is president emerita of [[St. Mary's College of Maryland]],<ref name=":1" /> and was president of Hollins College (now [[Hollins University]]).

== Biography ==
O'Brien received her [[Bachelor of Science|BS]] degree in biochemistry at [[Vassar College]] in 1975; and her [[PhD]] in chemistry at the [[University of Delaware]] in 1981.<ref name=":1" />

O'Brien served as president of St. Mary's College of Maryland in [[St. Mary's City, Maryland]], from 1996 to 2009.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" /> She was the president of [[Hollins College]] (now Hollins University) in [[Hollins, Virginia]], from 1991 to 1996.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite news |date=1995-12-07 |title=It's been an education |url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-roanoke-times-its-been-an-education/161219122/ |access-date=2024-12-20 |work=[[The Roanoke Times]] |pages=6 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>

While she was president of St. Mary's College of Maryland in 1998, a group of students on a study abroad trip to [[Guatemala]] experienced being robbed and five female students were [[gang rape]]d.<ref>"Guatemala's Violent past haunts scene of student rapes". ''[[Portland Press Herald]]''. 1998-01-25. p.&nbsp;[https://www.newspapers.com/article/portland-press-herald-guatemalas-violen/161219286/ 25], [https://www.newspapers.com/article/portland-press-herald-students/161219515/ 30]. Retrieved 2024-12-20 – via [[Newspapers.com]]. ISSN: 2689-5900</ref>
